faq.title: FAQ
faq.aboutText1: Trick surf server is a community gaming mode built on surf sliding mechanics. The server tracks player movements across the map and validates completed tricks based on trajectory zones.
faq.aboutPreStrafe: Pre-Strafe — Trick start must begin from a standstill start position, and tracking starts after jumping. Speed must not exceed 405.
faq.aboutUnlimited: Unlimited — Trick start can be anywhere with any entry speed.
